responsibility: Implements the GIMPLE pass laddress, which lowers non-invariant ADDR_EXPR computations into explicit pointer arithmetic. The pass scans SSA GIMPLE assignments, decomposes address expressions into a base object plus byte offset using get_inner_reference, forces offset and base subexpressions into GIMPLE temporaries when needed, and replaces address-of-component forms with POINTER_PLUS_EXPR computations to expose common subexpressions and improve later vectorization and optimization.
